runs.exclusion: Earlier adapter before adding the after-first-member bulk entry; not pooled with final-build samples.
Earlier adapter batches after two members; distinct protocol and build, not pooled with final-build samples.

notes: Source/executable hashes describe the three clean runs. Earlier adapter/protocol timing samples remain separately exploratory.

All performance runs were serial and guarded against game, launcher and WorldBuilder activity. Later legacy-fixture regression timings overlapped a native correctness test, are not performance-qualified, and are not included.

Original effect source setters and Begin/BeginPass/CommitChanges/EndPass/End remain. Synthetic Time advances 33 ms per pair, held constant within it. No retained material cache or effect-state filter.
Optimistic adapter relies on the independently modeled callee making exactly one DIP with no following device-state mutation. Native callee, exception and GPU failure contracts remain unproved.
The leader palette joins the batch. 288 modeled groups each draw 25 meshes with two instanced DIPs instead of one ordinary plus two instanced DIPs.

Every shadow map is cleared and redrawn. Lit pixels match exactly; shadow depths are within existing tolerance. Both regular and extra output are compared. Deliberately omitting visible leaders changes 2768 lit or 2516 shadow pixels across two frames.

Native hook stubs, production instancing code, exact logical scope counts, balanced method references and frame binding/constant restoration are checked. Prototype compiles with production general-register flags.
Final combined mode aggregates 24 members after the modeled leader returns. The earlier exploratory combined mode waits for two members.
Lit and shadow are alternative full workloads, not additive. No game Present, gameplay FPS, native scene traversal or source-callback timing is measured.
Log modification times are not exact start times.
